capabilities: Lock all Markdown notes to Reading view by default
Create view mode rules by folder, tag, or property value
Override locking per note via a properties field
Configure separate locking behavior for desktop, tablet, and phone
Toggle per-note and global locks with commands
extras: Documentation is available in English and Korean; localization follows the Obsidian app language, not the system language. No default hotkeys are set.
intentEvidence: Lock Obsidian notes to Reading, Live Preview, or Source mode.
problem: Obsidian lets users switch any note's view mode freely, so there is no way to pin specific notes or folders to Reading view or another mode across devices.
summary: Rule-based view mode limiter that locks Markdown notes to Reading, Live Preview, or Source mode per note, folder, tag, property, or device.
